# hyperlite_user (Data Source)

A local account, to give it rights (`hyperlite_acl`) or put it in a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_user" "alice" {
  username = "alice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The account's name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The account's name.
- `role` (String) Its global role: `viewer` or `admin`.
